description: LaunchDarkly feature-flag connector. Surfaces flag key, name, kind, tags, per-environment on/off state, maintainer, and timestamps into the local index as `launchdarkly:feature_flag` items — useful for incident correlation ("was this flag enabled when the alert fired?"). API-token auth. Regional / federal instances override `launchdarkly.base_url`; the SaaS host (app.launchdarkly.com) is the only one in the static sandbox manifest today (Task 14 runtime-merge follow-up). Write tools (each needs owner approval): `launchdarkly.flag.toggle` and `launchdarkly.flag.rollout.set`, one environment per call. The API token needs a role that can update flags.
author: Nimbus
